settings.title: How is this different from other digestive gummies?

settings.content: Bloat Gummies are designed to work quickly to help reduce bloating, ease stomach discomfort, and support smoother digestion when you need it most. They can help with that heavy or full feeling after eating, as well as occasional gas and digestive sluggishness. What makes them unique is their combination of fast-acting herbal support, prebiotic fiber, and a clinically-studied postbiotic, so they not only help you feel better in the moment but also support overall gut health over time.
settings.title: How do Bloat Gummies work?

settings.content: Bloat Gummies were intentionally built differently. Instead of using a traditional gummy base, we chose to formulate them with 5g of short-chain prebiotic fiber- so every part of the gummy is designed to support digestion, not just the active ingredients. scFOS can help nourish beneficial gut bacteria and support a more balanced, comfortable digestive environment, making it the best possible natural foundation for our gummy. Because it’s short-chain, it’s also gentle and easy to tolerate at our dose, so it works with your body without feeling heavy. Plus, it has a subtle natural sweetness, allowing us to create a delicious gummy without any sugar or sugar alcohols.
